items.source: Delegate the flushing to the transaction object, provided that the latter implements the SmartTransactionObject interface.
items.translation: 将刷新委托给事务对象，前提是后者实现了SmartTransactionObject接口。

items.source: Return whether the underlying transaction implements the SavepointManager interface and therefore supports savepoints.
items.translation: 返回底层事务是否实现了SavepointManager接口，从而支持保存点。

items.source: NOTE: This is not intended for use with other PlatformTransactionManager implementations, in particular not for mock transaction managers in testing environments. Use the alternative SimpleTransactionStatus class or a mock for the plain TransactionStatus interface instead.
items.translation: 注意： 此内容不适用于与其他 PlatformTransactionManager 实现一起使用，特别是在测试环境中不要用于模拟事务管理器。请使用替代的 SimpleTransactionStatus 类或针对普通 TransactionStatus 接口的模拟对象。

items.source: Holds all status information that AbstractPlatformTransactionManager needs internally, including a generic transaction object determined by the concrete transaction manager implementation.
items.translation: 包含 `AbstractPlatformTransactionManager` 内部所需的所有状态信息，包括由具体事务管理器实现确定的通用事务对象。

items.source: Supports delegating savepoint-related methods to a transaction object that implements the SavepointManager interface.
items.translation: 支持将保存点相关方法委托给实现了SavepointManager接口的事务对象。

items.source: The default implementation returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。

items.source: The default implementation returns false.
items.translation: 默认实现返回false。

items.source: Will return true if the global transaction itself has been marked rollback-only by the transaction coordinator, for example in case of a timeout.
items.translation: 如果全局事务本身已被事务协调器标记为仅回滚（例如在超时的情况下），则返回 `true`。

items.source: Return whether the progress of this transaction is debugged. This is used by AbstractPlatformTransactionManager as an optimization, to prevent repeated calls to logger.isDebugEnabled(). Not really intended for client code.
items.translation: 返回此事务的进度是否已调试。这由AbstractPlatformTransactionManager用作优化，以防止重复调用logger.isDebugEnabled()。并非真正打算供客户端代码使用。

items.source: This implementation exposes the SavepointManager interface of the underlying transaction object, if any.
items.translation: 此实现会暴露底层事务对象（如果有）的SavepointManager接口。

items.source: Determine the rollback-only flag via checking the transaction object, provided that the latter implements the SmartTransactionObject interface.
items.translation: 通过检查事务对象来确定回滚标志，前提是后者实现了SmartTransactionObject接口。

items.source: Create a new DefaultTransactionStatus instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的DefaultTransactionStatus实例。

items.source:
Return the holder for resources that have been suspended for this transaction,
if any.
items.translation: 返回此事务中已挂起的资源持有者（如果有）。

items.source: Return the underlying transaction object.
items.translation: 返回底层事务对象。

items.source: Return if a new transaction synchronization has been opened for this transaction.
items.translation: 如果为此事务已打开新的事务同步，则返回。

items.source: isGlobalRollbackOnly in class AbstractTransactionStatus
items.translation: `isGlobalRollbackOnly` 在类 `AbstractTransactionStatus` 中

items.source: getSavepointManager in class AbstractTransactionStatus
items.translation: `getSavepointManager` 类中的 `AbstractTransactionStatus`

items.source: NestedTransactionNotSupportedException - if savepoints are not supported
items.translation: NestedTransactionNotSupportedException - 如果不支持保存点

items.source: The "new" status can be transaction manager specific, for example, returning true for an actual nested transaction but potentially false for a savepoint-based nested transaction scope if the savepoint management is explicitly exposed (such as on TransactionStatus). A combined check for any kind of nested execution is provided by TransactionExecution.isNested().
items.translation: “new”状态可能因事务管理器而异，例如，对于实际嵌套事务返回true，但对于显式暴露保存点管理（如在TransactionStatus）的基于保存点的嵌套事务范围则可能返回false。由TransactionExecution.isNested()提供对任何类型嵌套执行的联合检查。

items.source: This is primarily here for transaction manager state handling. Prefer the use of TransactionExecution.hasTransaction() for application purposes since this is usually semantically appropriate.
items.translation: 这主要用于事务管理器状态处理。对于应用程序用途，请优先使用TransactionExecution.hasTransaction()，因为这通常更符合语义。

items.source: In case of Spring's declarative transactions, the exposed name will be the fully-qualified class name + "." + method name (by default).
items.translation: 在 Spring 声明式事务的情况下，暴露的名称默认为 `完全限定类名 + "." + 方法名`。

items.source: The default implementation returns an empty String.
items.translation: 默认实现返回一个空字符串。

items.source: Return whether there is an actual transaction active: this is meant to cover a new transaction as well as participation in an existing transaction, only returning false when not running in an actual transaction at all.
items.translation: 返回是否存在实际活动的事务：此方法旨在涵盖新事务以及参与现有事务的情况，仅在完全不处于实际事务中时返回 `false`。

items.source: Return the defined name of the transaction (possibly an empty String).
items.translation: 返回事务的已定义名称（可能为空字符串）。

items.source: Return whether the progress of this transaction is debugged.
items.translation: 返回此事务的进度是否处于调试状态。

items.source: Return if this transaction executes in a nested fashion within another.
items.translation: 如果此事务在另一个事务中以嵌套方式执行，则返回。

items.source:
Return whether the transaction manager considers the present transaction
as new; otherwise participating in an existing transaction, or potentially
not running in an actual transaction in the first place.
items.translation: 返回事务管理器是否将当前事务视为新事务；否则，表示正在参与现有事务，或者实际上并未运行在任何事务中。

items.source: Return if this transaction is defined as read-only transaction.
items.translation: 如果该事务被定义为只读事务，则返回。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no transaction is active
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果没有活动的事务

items.source: transactionName - the defined name of the transaction
items.translation: transactionName - 事务的已定义名称

items.source: transaction - underlying transaction object that can hold state for the internal transaction implementation
items.translation: transaction - 底层事务对象，可保存内部事务实现的状态

items.source: newTransaction - if the transaction is new, otherwise participating in an existing transaction
items.translation: newTransaction - 如果是新事务，否则参与现有事务

items.source: newSynchronization - if a new transaction synchronization has been opened for the given transaction
items.translation: newSynchronization - 如果已为给定事务打开新的事务同步。

items.source: readOnly - whether the transaction is marked as read-only
items.translation: readOnly - 是否将事务标记为只读

items.source: debug - should debug logging be enabled for the handling of this transaction? Caching it in here can prevent repeated calls to ask the logging system whether debug logging should be enabled.
items.translation: `debug` - 是否应为此事务的处理启用调试日志？在此处缓存它可以防止重复调用以询问日志系统是否应启用调试日志。

items.source: suspendedResources - a holder for resources that have been suspended for this transaction, if any
items.translation: <suspendedResources></suspendedResources> - 用于存储已挂起的资源（如果有）的持有者
